layouts.name: Interlomas
layouts.description: Draft association of the supplied venue-level entry to the existing independently mapped full course at Autódromo Interlomas. This venue has one supplied entry and one retained independent course, with a timing point on that course. Source trace distance 2295.8 m; supplied distance 2287 m. The association preserves the independent source geometry and remains provisional where corner configurations or historical distances differ.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap course and venue identity
sources.evidenceNote: Venue identity and trace coordinates come from the pinned OSM extract. The source identity identifies the facility; course configuration is provisional. No privately sourced coordinates enter the public database.
